Match the contents of **Column-I (Differential equation)** to **Column-II Solution (Integral curves)**:
Column IColumn II
(A) $y - x \frac{dy}{dx} = y^2 + \frac{dy}{dx}$(P) $y = A_1 x^2 + A_2 x + A_3$
(B) $(2x - 10y^3)\frac{dy}{dx} + y = 0$(Q) $x^2 y^2 + 1 = cy$
(C) $\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right)\left(\frac{d^3y}{dx^3}\right) - 3\left(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\right)^2 = 0$(R) $(x+1)(1-y) = cy$
(D) $(x^2y^2 - 1)dy + 2xy^3 dx = 0$(S) $x = A_1 y^2 + A_2 y + A_3$
(T) $xy^2 = 2y^5 + c$
